description.zh:
Alt-Svc功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Alt-Svc header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

description.zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include the `clear` parameter in the Alt-Svc header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: The parameter is included.

- `off`: The parameter is not included.

description.zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒。
description.en: The Max Age for the Alt-Svc header, in seconds. The default is 86400.

description.zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include the `persist` parameter in the Alt-Svc header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: The parameter is included.

- `off`: The parameter is not included.

description.zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS). Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

description.zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include the `includeSubDomains` directive in the HSTS header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: The directive is included.

- `off`: The directive is not included.
The value of the `max-age` directive for the HSTS header, in seconds.

description.zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS Preload by including the `preload` directive in the HSTS header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: The directive is included.

- `off`: The directive is not included.

description.zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Force HTTPS. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

description.zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：
- 301
- 302
- 307
- 308
description.en:
The Redirection Status Code to use when Force HTTPS is enabled. Valid values:

- `301`

- `302`

- `307`

- `308`

description.zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to reject TLS Handshake Requests that do not include an SNI. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Rejects requests without an SNI.

- `off`: Allows requests without an SNI.

description.zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI) verification. Disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

description.zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔。
description.en: Specifies the allowlist of SNI values. Separate multiple values with a space.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The content of the Rule, which is a Conditional Expression that matches user Requests. This parameter is optional when adding a Global Configuration. Supported use cases include:

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, use a custom expression. For example: `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`.

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is optional when adding a Global Configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: The rule is enabled.

- `off`: The rule is disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The name of the Rule. This parameter is optional when adding a Global Configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The execution order of the rule. A lower value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the Site. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API.

description.zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The Site's configuration Version. For Sites with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the Version to which the configuration applies. The default is 0.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-https-application-configuration --site-id 1234560000 --site-version 1 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --https-force on --https-force-code 301 --alt-svc on --alt-svc-clear on --alt-svc-persist on --alt-svc-ma 86400 --hsts on --hsts-max-age 3600 --hsts-include-subdomains on --hsts-preload on --sequence 1 --https-sni-verify on --https-no-sni-deny on --https-sni-whitelist abc_edf --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateHttpsApplicationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --HstsIncludeSubdomains on --AltSvcMa 86400 --RuleEnable on --HttpsForceCode 301 --AltSvc on --HttpsNoSniDeny on --Hsts on --HstsPreload on --HstsMaxAge 3600 --Sequence 1 --HttpsSniWhitelist abc_edf --AltSvcPersist on --HttpsSniVerify on --AltSvcClear on --HttpsForce on --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --SiteVersion 1 --RuleName rule_example
